title: Tesla Coil Portrait
description: A glowing plasma globe contains a large demonic face with sharp teeth and glowing eyes, its mouth formed by a spiky purple and blue tesla coil structure emitting electrical arcs. Above it floats a portrait of Nikola Tesla surrounded by green leaves, pink dripping liquid, and yellow lightning against a dark cloudy background.
prompt: Surreal dark painting of a large plasma globe containing a demonic grinning face with sharp teeth and glowing eyes, its mouth constructed from a glowing purple and blue spiky tesla coil with electrical arcs shooting upward to a floating portrait of Nikola Tesla with mustache. Green leaves and pink dripping liquid surround the glass sphere, dramatic lighting, dark cloudy background with yellow lightning.
